name: ESO
description: Elite Site Optimizer helps businesses analyze and improve their websites through SEO, accessibility, performance, security, content, and AI-readiness audits, with actionable recommendations for better visibility and user experience.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ESO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ESO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.elitesiteoptimizer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ESO MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ESO lists 15 MCP tools, including get_accessibility_report, get_accessibility_score_report, get_ai_citation_report, get_ai_content_optimizer_report, get_ai_readiness_report, get_analysis_summary_report, get_backlinks_research_report, get_link_checker_report, get_on_page_crawl_report, get_performance_report, get_rank_checker_report, and get_schema_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ESO?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ESO in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
ESO requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ESO is developed by Elite Site Optimizer. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
